description: This source file contains definitions for Orleans grains with dependency injection, including classes for grains, services, and their implementations, as well as related interfaces and logging.

classes.name: DIGrainWithInjectedServices
classes.description: A Orleans grain that demonstrates dependency injection of singleton and scoped services, with methods to retrieve service values and manage grain lifecycle.

classes.name: ExplicitlyRegisteredSimpleDIGrain
classes.description: A grain class that is explicitly registered, demonstrating injection of services and simple state retrieval.

classes.name: InjectedService
classes.description: Implementation of IInjectedService, providing timestamp and instance value, with logging on disposal.

classes.name: InjectedScopedService
classes.description: Implementation of IInjectedScopedService, providing a unique instance value and logging on disposal.

methods.name: GetLongValue
methods.description: Returns a task with the current timestamp in ticks or a stored value.

methods.name: GetStringValue
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the grain's ID or a stored string.

methods.name: GetInjectedSingletonServiceValue
methods.description: Returns the value from the injected singleton service.

methods.name: GetInjectedScopedServiceValue
methods.description: Returns the value from the injected scoped service.

methods.name: GetGrainFactoryId
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the injected grain factory.

methods.name: AssertCanResolveSameServiceInstances
methods.description: Checks if the service instances resolved from the service provider are the same as injected instances.

methods.name: GetLongValue
methods.description: Returns a long value indicating the number of times the grain has been activated or a stored count.

methods.name: GetStringValue
methods.description: Returns a string value stored in the grain.

methods.name: GetTicks
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time in ticks.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Logs disposal of the service instance.
